title: Look up member and read savings balance
description: Looks up a member by their member ID and retrieves the current balance of their savings account. Requires a member ID as input (e.g. "10001"); returns the member's savings account balance (e.g. "4,210.33") along with contextual details such as member name, status, and branch visible on the search result. This is a read-only operation and does not modify any data.

step_intents.intent: Enter the member number into the search field
Submit the member search for the given member ID
Extract the savings account balance for the looked-up member
